name: B10-0147/2026 (Renew) – Four years of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and European contributions to a just peace and sustained security for Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on four years of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and European contributions to a just peace and sustained security for Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for continued support for Ukraine four years after Russia's full-scale invasion. It asks the European Union to keep sanctions on Russia, send more weapons including air defence, and use frozen Russian assets to help pay for Ukraine's needs. It says any peace deal must protect Ukraine's territory and security, and that Ukraine should join the European Union. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks the European Union to send more weapons and use frozen Russian assets for Ukraine.
- It calls for more sanctions on Russia and a full ban on Russian oil and gas imports.
- It backs Ukraine's European Union membership and a peace deal that protects Ukraine's territory.
